acceptance.behavior: Named styles propagate and link the selection in a single document transaction. Updates reach separate pages, continuous canvas and master, honoring property protection.
test: saving a named style propagates to linked pages and master before linking selection, atomically

acceptance.behavior: Mixed selection edits each gradient stop independently; unrelated stops, type, angle and differing stop counts survive. Add/remove respect2–20 stops.
test: mixed-gradient stop editing preserves unrelated stops, each gradient type and differing counts

acceptance.behavior: SVG affine normalization retains open paths, inherited paint alpha and true root/nested group opacity. Composite containers apply group opacity once to overlapping children. Group opacity is editable in Layers.
test: SVG skew and reflection preserve open paths rather than adding a closing stroke
inherited SVG fill/stroke opacity and root/group compositing survive parsing and render once
risks: Non-orthogonal imported curves are sampled with existing vector tolerance; native orthogonal curves stay exact.

acceptance.behavior: Dragging photo crops solves the actual cover/contain paint translation including zoom, flips and element rotation, leaving zero-overflow axes stable. Photo frames share the calculation.
test: crop translation uses cover/contain painted overflow and zero-overflow leaves the axis stable
rotated, flipped, zoomed crop math matches the actual nested CSS paint translation
risks: Missing intrinsic and not-yet-decoded image dimensions use frame aspect until decoding.

acceptance.behavior: Case changes operate on decoded Unicode text tokens and re-escape them; inline styles, texture references and the plain mirror stay synchronized.
test: case conversion decodes entities before Unicode case while keeping styles, textures and mirror consistent

acceptance.behavior: Keyboard selection uses the same group unit as pointer selection; Layers dragging expands unselected or partially selected group children. Isolation permits children, inherited locks block reorder.
test: Layers keyboard selection and dragging an unselected or partially selected nested group remain group operations

acceptance.behavior: Focusable resize and rotation handles react to arrow keys, with Shift larger steps, shared anchored geometry and appearance protection. Enter/Space opens help; Escape/Done exits and a live status announces dimensions.
test: keyboard resize keeps the opposite edge anchored and preserves protected appearance

acceptance.behavior: Canvas hit tests actual filled geometry, masks, holes, rounded corners, clips and physical strokes. Transparent corners pass through. Primary-modifier click cycles underlying layers, respecting groups, isolation and visibility. Context and double-click resolve the same geometry.
test: geometry selects the painted interior, ignores transparent corners/holes and cycles depth in group units
stroke hit geometry distinguishes inside/outside borders, open paths, clips, hidden groups and opacity0
risks: Raster alpha and text glyph outlines retain the image/text frame hit area; geometric masks are precise.

acceptance.behavior: Select and persistent Hand tools are visible, with H/V shortcuts. Two fingers pan and pinch; pointer-count changes reset baselines and cancel an edit gesture without committing it. Hand arrows pan rather than nudge artwork.
test: one-finger Hand and two-finger pan/pinch compute client deltas without pointer-count jumps
risks: Full touch-pointer device validation belongs to integrated browser QA.

acceptance.behavior: Auto-fit retains requested nominal size separately from the measured size, grows again after shorter content and supports minimum/maximum in progressive text options. Rich font sizes scale consistently in editing and saved rendering, font load re-measures and bounds/styles round-trip.
test: autofit recovers nominal size when content shrinks and honors configured minimum and maximum
autofit measures rich sizes relatively and restores exact DOM styles after measurement
risks: Previously shrunk legacy nominal sizes cannot be inferred; users set their desired size once.

acceptance.behavior: Visible Nodes tool edits anchors and incoming/outgoing Bezier handles by pointer or keyboard, adds/removes anchors, converts curve/corner, mirrors handles and opens/closes subpaths. Pen exposes Finish/Remove/Cancel and an open/closed option. Reframing preserves rotated scene-space geometry.
test: node parser preserves cubic, smooth, quadratic, arc and open/closed subpath semantics
adding a cubic anchor preserves the actual curve and moving an anchor moves both handles
node reframing preserves world geometry for rotated paths and degenerate open lines
node actions expose curve/corner, insertion/deletion and open/closed paths without throwing on bounds
risks: SVG arcs normalize to cubic segments of at most45 degrees, with maximum relative error below0.00001.

acceptance.behavior: A single typed command registry drives keyboard resolution and visible help, including history alternatives, group/layer order, Hand/Select/Nodes/Pen and zoom/fit; gesture descriptions expose depth, Alt duplicate and touch. Native input activation and composition are respected.
test: command execution and shortcut help share one registry, including redo, groups, depth and touch
risks: Root integration retains native system clipboard event handlers instead of the old base-commit handlers.
